lower_bound_proof: For any nonpreemptive schedule of the fixed lowered DAG, each exclusive resource must execute all assigned nonnegative node durations; makespan>=max resource_work.
DAG longest path is a lower bound independent of resource order. Current CPP computes it in topological node order.

Every job owns its chip from acquiring command start until output-channel drain. Command,input,compute,output form a serial chain and all jobs on a chip have disjoint lock intervals. Hence makespan>=initial_submit+max_chip sum(chain_duration). Queue waits only enlarge the lock spans.

All controller commands, channel transfers and PCIe work are causally after the initial host submission. Therefore initial_submit+their respective total/maximum resource work are valid. The combine/submission/activation host work is also serial on the one modeled host resource.

The backend maximum of resource_work,longest_path,submit+chip_owned_work andsubmit+controller_work is valid for that fixed modeled graph. It is not a lower bound on all alternative geometries/replications/cache policies or unspecified native capabilities.

selection_audit.LB_validity: select_pairs uses a subset of valid chip/controller/PCIe/channel/host lower bounds after actual block lowering. reshape(routes,chips/channels,channels).sum(1) matches chip%channels exactly. selection_audit.certification: For a sorted finite pool, if the next lower bound is>=incumbent mean then every remaining candidate cannot improve it. Complete traversal has the same implication. Budget termination sets stopped=true and certification=false. Reusing a feasible smaller-family incumbent preserves the proof.
selection_audit.qualification: Certificate is mean latency only for frozen per-phase-fitted labels, finite profiles,16relative rotations, fixed shared geometry, this training selection set and this greedy schedule. It does not certify p99, all label assignments, all row partitions, optimal scheduling or capacity-constrained/all-layer placement.
selection_audit.assumptions: Queries are nonempty and K matches shape.active, candidate labels are unique identifiers, required families exist, replay budget>=1 for the initial family, and ns totals/means fit supported integer/float ranges. Current internal callers satisfy these; direct select_pairs budget0 has no initial incumbent; newer CLI now explicitly rejects nonpositive replay budgets.
selection_audit.float_note: Default64 selection queries and ordinary hardware-scale integer ns make means exactly representable in the relevant range. A theorem over arbitrary large service values should compare integer total costs/bounds rather than rely on floating means.
selection_audit.shared_scope: Shared minD/minW row geometries are fixed identically across families, with no claim that all shared shapes/rotations were optimized.

physical_and_lowering_limits: Lowering minimizes waves among the minimum number of one-block jobs, not total native latency across all legal splits. B3,C2,L3,R12 gives3×4rows=9waves;4×3rows=8waves may be faster if a read wave outweighs one extra command/reload/drain. Existing function docstring correctly states this lexicographic policy.

BFD is a legal allocation heuristic, not an optimal capacity oracle. Capacity10 with wave items5,4,3,3,3,2 uses3blocks though[5,3,2] and[4,3,3] use2. A heuristic overflow cannot prove all packings infeasible.

chip_blocks counts aligned P-plane block bundles at the same block index, eachL*P*page_bytes coefficient/LSB bytes. It is not the number of individual plane blocks. Bad blocks, CSB/MSB data, attention/dense weights, FTL overhead and overprovisioning are excluded.

run_one address artifacts are layer-local atblock0 with no chip_blocks budget supplied. Newer assemble_models source (added after audited snapshot) concatenates jobs/logical ranges with global expert/job offsets and repacks jointly; its final physical artifacts have not yet been independently validated. No verdict about the pending full campaign/global capacity is implied by the single-layer audit.

Rows can cross pages/planes within one native job, but each dot uses the full original input and a fresh native accumulator. Native continuation across blocks and host column partial sums are not used. Coefficient pages and full-wave reservation are separately ledgered.

Fringe0 requires a valid useful-row stop; fringe1 emits floor(requested_pages*pagebytes/C), fringe2 floor(waves*B/C). Integer counts and drains were checked, but actual PE cutoff/partial-row flush/erased-page handling remain interface assumptions, not measured silicon behavior.
numerical_and_metadata_scope: No PE numerical simulation is present. A whole-row relocation proof applies conditionally if the original native function is row-separable and receives the same complete coefficient row,column sequence,input bytes,dimensions,row metadata and arithmetic mode, with fresh invocation reset. No rawI32 return or column reassociation is needed.

Output/scales/rounding/valid-row cutoff contracts remain unpublished for AiF. HostFP32 row scales can stay in original logical order and be accounted separately, as in host-row-gather/ledger.json; they must not silently consume or be interpreted as INT8 coefficient bytes.

The physical virtual certificate must eventually be connected to an actual weight programmer and controller command/address lowering. Shape/address software consistency is distinct from fabricated hardware/native numerical execution.

Channels are uniform chip%channels and chips divisible by channels. Multiple LUNs, plane-private contexts, page-buffer replay and arbitrary concurrent inputs are not added. Zero input_buffer_bytes means unspecified capability, not proven unlimited native capacity.

aif_input_buffer_evidence.paper_evidence: AiF reuses PBs belonging to each plane; latches each hold one page. TLC has at least four latches, and the described be-enc input allocation repurposes two otherwise-unused read latches. Text describes typical input vectors8–32KiB.
aif_input_buffer_evidence.inference: Two16KiB input latches per plane describe32KiB capacity for that allocation. This is not a disclosed ISA vectorDim hard maximum, an independent-plane-input proof, or permission to aggregate buffer capacity across planes.
